newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Bid at lower level on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Bid at lower level on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were bid at a lower level on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- One barge, Illinois River, next week, bid 105 percent of tariff, no offer, no comparison.
- Two barges, Illinois River, one each week of April 20 and April 27, bid 100 percent, no offer, no comparison.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of May, bid 120 percent, no offer, no comparison.
- Four barges, one each week of May, bid 145 percent, no offer, no comparison.
- Eight barges, mid-Mississippi, one each week of May and June, bid 115 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Wednesday, offered 125 percent.
